cards.d: An accessory is a thing that is added to another thing to make it look better.
cards.e: The store sold colorful accessories like bags, sunglasses, and makeup.
cards.ielts: Fashion accessories such as handbags and watches are often bought as status symbols rather than for practical reasons.

cards.d: An acquisition is something that a person buys or gets in some way.
cards.e: Marty was happy with his new acquisition: a very fast bicycle.
cards.ielts: The museum's latest acquisition, a rare medieval manuscript, has attracted thousands of visitors since it went on display.

cards.d: When something is adequate, it is good enough for something else.
cards.e: Without adequate notice of the road block, they will have to turn around.
cards.ielts: Many rural clinics lack adequate equipment, which means patients must travel long distances for basic tests.

cards.d: Cardboard is a material made out of stiff paper. It is often used to make boxes.
cards.e: We packed our things into cardboard boxes and moved to our new home.
cards.ielts: Online shopping has greatly increased the amount of cardboard packaging that households throw away every week.

cards.d: A dilemma is a difficult situation in which a choice has to be made.
cards.e: Choosing either the tastier or healthier drink proved to be quite a dilemma.
cards.ielts: Governments face a dilemma between protecting jobs in the coal industry and meeting their climate targets.

cards.d: When something is elaborate, it contains a lot of details.
cards.e: She gave the teacher an elaborate explanation of her project.
cards.ielts: Some families spend a fortune on elaborate weddings, money which could instead be used to buy a home.

cards.d: To facilitate something is to make it easier.
cards.e: To facilitate the meeting, Melissa used a simple computer program.
cards.ielts: Digital technology can facilitate communication between parents and teachers, especially in large schools.

cards.d: A fleet is a group of ships.
cards.e: The fleet of ships spent a few days at the dock.
cards.ielts: A large foreign fishing fleet operating off the coast has caused local fish stocks to decline dramatically.

cards.d: A grid is a pattern of squares with numbers and letters to find places on a map.
cards.e: We located our town using the grid.
cards.ielts: City planners often design new districts on a grid, which makes them easier for visitors to navigate.

cards.d: To import means to bring in a product from another country.
cards.e: Foods that have been imported are usually more expensive.
cards.ielts: Countries that import most of their food are especially vulnerable when global prices rise suddenly.

cards.d: To infer something is to decide it is true based on other information one has.
cards.e: By the position of the sun in the sky, she inferred that it was noon.
cards.ielts: From the data provided, we can infer that rising incomes led to greater spending on leisure activities.

cards.d: To inflate something means to fill it up with air.
cards.e: I helped him inflate the balloons.
cards.ielts: Cyclists are advised to inflate their tyres regularly, as properly filled tyres make riding safer and more efficient.

cards.d: When something is innate, it is something that one is born with, it is not learned.
cards.e: He had the innate desire to please his teachers.
cards.ielts: Some people believe that musical talent is innate, while others argue that it can be developed through practice.

cards.d: Marble is a type of rock that feels cold and is smooth when cut.
cards.e: The large house had floors made of marble.
cards.ielts: Luxury hotels with marble floors and gold decorations consume enormous amounts of energy and natural resources.

cards.d: A mast is a long pole on a ship that holds the sail.
cards.e: The mast held both sails of the ship upright.
cards.ielts: Some modern cargo ships are being fitted with tall masts and sails to cut fuel use and reduce emissions.

cards.d: Nausea is the feeling of being sick to your stomach.
cards.e: The doctor said the medicine would help get rid of her nausea.
cards.ielts: Common side effects of the medicine include nausea and headaches, so patients should take it with food.

cards.d: When something is naval, it relates to a country’s navy or military ships.
cards.e: The country sent all of its naval forces to protect them.
cards.ielts: The country increased its naval spending significantly in order to protect important shipping routes.

cards.d: A pouch is a small, flexible bag that is usually made of cloth.
cards.e: I keep my money in a small pouch.
cards.ielts: Instead of plastic bags, some shops now provide cloth pouches that customers can reuse many times.

cards.d: If something is saturated, it is completely wet.
cards.e: Leigh’s hair became saturated in the rain storm.
cards.ielts: After weeks of heavy rain, the saturated soil could no longer absorb water, which led to severe flooding.

cards.d: An update is an act of making something more modern.
cards.e: I’m doing an update on my personal phone directory.
cards.ielts: Regular software updates are essential for protecting personal data from hackers and viruses.
